changes.evidence: Loki S1: after working for the TVA in episodes 1-2, Loki abandons Mobius at the end of episode 2 and follows Sylvie through her timedoor, then in episode 3 takes her to Lamentis-1 and proposes they overthrow the TVA together; he is caught and arrested in episode 4 and pruned, and stays against the TVA through episodes 5-6. In Loki S2 episode 1 he is back working with Mobius and the TVA. Add 'Loki S1' to left.

Remove 'Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2' from left. Nebula already belongs to no group after leaving Thanos and Ronan in Guardians of the Galaxy; in Vol. 2 she only partners with Taserface's mutineers for a bounty share (an ally, not a member) and then goes off alone to hunt Thanos, so there is no group for her to leave in that title.

owner_calls.question: In Secret Invasion episode 1, Talos tells Fury he has been exiled from the Skrull Council (Gravik took his place and the Earth Skrulls follow Gravik). Does that end his 'Skrulls' stage?
options: Keep 'Skrulls' (he is still a Skrull working for the refugees' future)
Add ['Independent','Secret Invasion'] and add 'Secret Invasion' to left (voted out of the Skrull leadership)
owner_calls.evidence: Secret Invasion ep 1 'Resurrection': Talos says G'iah has defected to Gravik and that he was exiled from the Skrull Council. He then works alongside Fury (an ally) until Gravik kills him in episode 4.
